mini.unsupported: The browser does not support the mini window
mini.onlyLive: The mini window is available while the stream is live
mini.openFailed: Could not open the mini window:
mini.pip: Mini window on top of all windows
mini.noHls: The browser does not support HLS

mod.banText: {name} won't be able to write in the channel chat.
mod.timeoutText: For how many seconds should {name} be timed out?

chat.clearText: All messages will disappear for all viewers.

chatMode.title: Chat settings
chatMode.hint: Filtered words show as ****, viewers can reveal the message. The OBS overlay always shows the asterisks. Limits do not apply to the streamer and moderators.

raid.btnTitle: Raid: send your viewers to another stream
raid.nobody: Nobody else is live right now
raid.seconds: Send viewers in how many seconds (5–120)
raid.sent: Raid sent — viewers are on their way

emotes.followToUse: Follow the channel to use its emotes
emotes.manageHint: In chat an emote is written as :code:. Channel emotes are for your followers and moderators, public ones are for everyone in every chat.
emotes.fileHint: PNG, WebP or JPG are scaled down to 112 px. GIF is uploaded as is, up to 256 KB. Code — 2–20 Latin letters, digits or “_”.
emotes.empty: No emotes yet — pick an image, come up with a code and click “Upload”.
emotes.animatedNoPublic: An animated emote can't be made public
emotes.publicHint: Public — everyone can use it in every chat
emotes.gifBig: The GIF is larger than 256 KB — make it smaller

timeout.desc: Mute for a while: 90, 10m, 2h, 1d (10 minutes by default)

slow.desc: Slow mode: 3, 5, 10, 30, 60 or 120 s (30 by default)

followers.desc: Followers only; follow age: 10m, 30m, 1h, 1d (none — right away)

spAdd.desc: Give channel points to a viewer (streamer only)

spSub.desc: Take channel points from a viewer, not below zero (streamer only)

timer.desc: Countdown: /timer 5 — five minutes, also 90s, 1h30m, 10:00; pause, reset, +1m, -30s

goal.desc: Goal with your own number: no word — +1

text.desc: Change the text widget (no text — clear it)

ticker.desc: Change the ticker (no text — clear it)

credits.desc: Roll the end credits (stop — stop them)

w.desc: Custom widget: number, reroll random, change the text

points.needText: Write a text for this reward
points.testHint: You own the channel: no points are spent, the reward runs for real

terms.needText: To use your account, please read and accept the Party Watcher Terms of Service.
terms.changedTitle: The Terms of Service have changed
terms.changedText: We have updated our Terms of Service. Please read the new version and confirm your agreement to continue.
terms.agree: I am 18 or older and accept the Terms of Service

consent.text: The site only uses necessary cookies (sign-in, language, protection from hacking). We collect visit statistics (device, browser, country) only with your consent.

attach.hint: {n} of {max} · Ctrl+V or drag and drop also work
attach.notImage: This is not an image (PNG, JPG, WebP work)
attach.wait: Wait, the images are still being prepared

fb.mailLimit: You chose to get replies by email, but the site has already sent all the emails it can today (daily limit), so the reply came here.
fb.mailFailed: You chose to get replies by email, but the email could not be sent, so the reply came here.

welcome.title: Welcome to Party Watcher!
welcome.text: Support replies, site news and important account events will appear here. You can choose what to show in the settings.

accepted.title: Request accepted
accepted.text: Your request “{topic}” (#{n}) has been accepted for review. Thank you!

trivial.title: Request reviewed
trivial.text: Your request “{topic}” (#{n}) has been reviewed and processed. Still have a question? Write in the conversation.

report.title: Report reviewed
report.text: Your report “{topic}” (#{n}) has been reviewed by moderation. Thanks for helping!

login.title: Sign-in from a new device
login.text: {device}{where}. If this wasn’t you, end the session in “Devices” and change your password.

password.title: Password changed
password.text: Other devices have been signed out. If this wasn’t you, contact support right away.

passwordReset.title: Password reset via email link
passwordReset.text: All previous sign-ins have been ended. If this wasn’t you, contact support right away.

emailRequest.title: Email change requested
emailRequest.text: A link was sent to {to}. Until it is opened, the account email stays the same.

username.title: Support changed your username
username.text: {from} → {to}. Sign in with the new username.

deleteCancel.title: Account deletion cancelled
deleteCancel.text: You signed in with your password — the account stays with you.

expiring.title: Room will be deleted soon
expiring.text: Nobody has been in “{name}” for a while — it will be deleted in {h} h. Join it to keep it.

expired.title: Room deleted
expired.text: The room “{name}” was empty for {h} h and was deleted automatically.

clip.title: New clip on your channel
clip.text: {name} made a clip of your stream

many.one: {name} made a clip, plus {n} more clip of your stream
many.other: {name} made a clip, plus {n} more clips of your stream

unmod.title: You are no longer a moderator
unmod.text: The channel {channel} removed you from its moderators.

ban.title: Banned from chat
ban.text: You were banned from the chat of {channel}.

removed.title: Preset removed by moderation
removed.text: Your preset “{preset}” was removed by the administration because it broke the site rules. Think this is a mistake? Contact support.

float.hint: Mini panel: stream uptime, chat, events and widget buttons in a window above all apps (Chrome, Edge, Opera, Yandex on a computer)
float.title: Party Watcher — Mini panel
float.blocked: The browser blocked the window — allow pop-ups for this site
float.noPip: This browser can’t keep a window above all apps — a regular window was opened. Always on top works in Chrome, Edge, Opera or Yandex Browser on a computer
